output.english_question: Does Clause 7.4 of the Example UCB Retail Loan Policy v3 (effective 1 April 2023), which imposes foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the outstanding principal for all term loans pre-closed by the borrower, comply with the RBI’s current rules?
sub_queries: RBI guidelines foreclosure charges prepayment penalty 2% plus GST term loan
RBI master directions prepayment charges due to foreclosure pre-closure retail loans
UCB Example Retail Loan Policy v3 Clause 7.4 foreclosure charge 2% GST compliance
premises: The policy clause applies to all term loans pre-closed/foreclosed by the borrower.
Foreclosure/prepayment charges are calculated as 2% plus GST on the outstanding principal.
The question is assessing compliance with RBI’s current (as-of-now) rules for prepayment/foreclosure charges.
